enabled.description: Simultaneous Ring is enabled or not.

doNotRingIfOnCallEnabled.description: When set to `true`, the configured phone numbers won't ring when on a call.

phoneNumbers.description: Enter up to 10 phone numbers to ring simultaneously when a workspace phone receives an incoming call.

criteria.description: A list of criteria specifying conditions when simultaneous ring is in effect.

criteriasEnabled.description: When `true`, enables the selected schedule for simultaneous ring.
